meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取和分析代谢网络模型（如 SBML 格式），运行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量变异分析（FVA）、基因敲除模拟，并帮助设计培养基或补全模型。
howto.when: 当你说“代谢模型”、“FBA”、“基因敲除”等关键词，或要求做通量模拟、培养基设计、模型补全时触发。

say.text: 加载textbook模型，跑一次FBA，告诉我生长速率和主要通量。
say.note: 会调用cobrapy计算并输出结果。

say.text: 对iJO1366做单基因敲除筛选，找出必需基因。
用最小培养基算出要达到50%最大生长需要哪些组分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load and analyze metabolic network models (e.g., SBML), run flux balance analysis (FBA), flux variability analysis (FVA), gene knockout simulations, and assist with media design or model gap-filling.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like "metabolic model", "FBA", or "gene knockout", or ask for flux simulation, media design, or model gap-filling, this skill activates.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model, run FBA, and report the growth rate and major fluxes.
say_en.note: Uses cobrapy to compute and output results.

say_en.text: Perform single-gene deletions on iJO1366 to find essential genes.
Calculate the minimal medium for 50% of maximum growth.
